# PRD-EVD-01

**Was every piece of evidence the assessment relies on produced against the version being released?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | EVD: Evidence |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `evidence.design_version`, `design.version` |

## Why it matters

Evidence from an earlier version describes a different solution.

## Rule

Every evidence entry cited by a finding or required by a criterion of this lens has design_version equal to design.version; any other is reported, and the criterion it would have answered is not-assessed.
